purpose: Evidence-backed composition-grade genre contracts for the AI Composer. Research workspace only; not live runtime authority.

percentage_definitions.population_mass_percent: Relative physical/ensemble mass within a typical formation. Not a direct gain multiplier.
percentage_definitions.presence_percent: Estimated likelihood the instrument/section appears in the genre or selected subgenre.
percentage_definitions.activity_percent: Estimated share of musical time in which the instrument/section is active.
percentage_definitions.musical_agency_percent: Share of meaningful compositional responsibility over the whole piece; distinct from loudness and player count.
percentage_definitions.foreground_window_percent: Estimated share of time the instrument/section carries foreground or featured material.
percentage_definitions.spatial_footprint_percent: Relative width/depth allocation when active; not loudness.
